text_block_list.text: —The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...In high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"So, it's finally my turn... The Tenno Sho 
(Spring), is it?"
choice_data_list: A race with special ties, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Me, Big Sis, and the Mejiro family. The 
stage of the Shield, steeped in memories 
of countless "storms"—
—Pardon me.

I apologize for intruding when your race 
is fast approaching, but could I have a 
moment of your time?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: This voice is—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Going out of your way to encourage me... I 
am truly obliged.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is mine. I know it might seem 
impolite, but I really wanted to speak to 
you directly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's that special of a race to 
us."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —This way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good day, Dream Journey-sama.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Bright-san...!

...Mejiro Bright. A horse girl of the 
Mejiro family, she carries a very gentle 
aura, but—

Just like Mejiro McQueen, she has won the 
Tenno Sho (Spring), making her a bona fide 
child of the Mejiro glory.

"And above all...— She debuted in the same 
generation as Stay Gold, and actually 
competed with him in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—I can recall it as if it happened only 
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Competing against her... in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Me as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Your running on that day truly…… shone 
with brilliant radiance—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis, who watched it all from up 
close... looked like she was having a lot 
of fun, too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That Journey-sama, who inherited the 
Mejiro way of running... is running today 
in the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The sheer power of the time we have built 
together... I can feel it tugging tightly 
at my heart.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Please, take a look.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I shall show you a run that brings no 
shame upon you, McQueen-san, or Big Sis."
(WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, Dream Journey... feels extra 
fired up today...!

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm getting chills...! I can't wait to 
see how she runs...!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Let us be on our way—
